open_questions.text: Q1. Is priority to be claimed from any earlier filing? If so, supply it under intake/priority/ and re-run this prompt (claims most exposed: 26, 40-44, 66, 67; ranges of 11, 19, 33, 53, 68; claim 4). If not, confirm that this is the first filing.
